# The GEO Cookbook

> Six reproducible experiments on the machine legibility of web content for generative answer engines. Each pairs a before/after artifact with a deterministic offline script, and reports the measured property with its proxy, sample size, confidence and limitations. Every number is an offline machine-legibility proxy; none measures retrieval, reranking, generation or citation by any engine. Companion to the GEO Handbook. By Fernando Aporta Franco (ferinazumaDEV). Version 0.1.1 · 2026-09-04 · CC BY 4.0 prose, MIT code.

## Recipes
- [SSR vs CSR rendering](04-technical/ssr-vs-csr-rendering/): what an AI crawler sees with and without JavaScript — measured 6 → 152 visible words (~25×), reproducible offline.
- [Structured data (JSON-LD)](04-technical/structured-data-jsonld/): how many typed facts a schema.org / JSON-LD parser can extract from the page — measured 0 → 17 typed entities and 0 → 37 typed facts, reproducible offline.
- [AI crawler access](04-technical/ai-crawler-access/): whether AI crawlers are allowed by robots.txt and handed a curated llms.txt — measured 0 → 8 of 8 AI user-agents allowed and 0 → 2,868 bytes of llms.txt, reproducible offline.
- [Chunk-friendly structure](03-content/chunk-friendly-structure/): how many chunks survive a fixed-size splitter (chunk_size = 800) as self-contained units — measured 0 of 5 → 5 of 5 self-contained chunks, reproducible offline.
- [Entity clarity with sameAs](05-authority/entity-clarity-sameas/): how many named entities resolve to exactly one canonical Wikidata ID — measured 0 → 5 of 5 entities resolved, reproducible offline.
- [Citation anchoring](06-measurement/citation-anchoring/): how many claims carry an inline, linkable source a parser can lift as a claim→source pair — measured 0 → 8 of 8 claim→source pairs, reproducible offline.

## Meta
- [Archived releases (Zenodo)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22299279): every tagged release from v0.1.1 onward archived with a DOI; this concept DOI always resolves to the latest one. Cite this rather than the repository URL.
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): versioned history of the recipes and the dataset.
- [About (machine-readable)](about.jsonld): schema.org JSON-LD — source of truth for name, author, version, DOI, dateModified, maturity.
- [How to cite](CITATION.cff): Aporta Franco, Fernando. The GEO Cookbook, v0.1.1 (2026-09-04). DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22299279.
- [Claims and maturity](CLAIMS.md): what each recipe measures (reproducible) and what it does not (engine effect: experimental).
- Maturity: not yet set in about.jsonld — see CLAIMS.md.
- [README](README.md): how recipes are structured (before / after / measurement / reproduce).
- [Ecosystem](ECOSYSTEM.md): how this fits the GEO cluster by Fernando Aporta Franco.
- [Offline measurements dataset](dataset/README.md): the six recipes' before/after numbers as CSV and JSON, with units, sample sizes and limitations; regenerated from the recipes with one command.
